headline: Unusual trading is concentrated in FOOD and CONMAT, led by SST, F&D and PPP, while TRITN and EMC posted sharp price gaps.
market_take: Coverage shows sharp dispersion, with EMC +100.00% and SQ +5.88% leading the top movers, while PF -20.00%, PPP -10.29% and CGD -10.00% lagged. Five-day gains were strongest in TRITN +50.0% and TTCL +33.3%, while KC -33.3% and A -23.5% were the largest declines. Filings include multiple SCGD earnings releases and a share-repurchase resolution, plus high-materiality acquisition notices for TU and ITC.
